name: FormZero Cloudflare Self-Hosted Form Backend
free_limit: MIT-licensed FormZero source with unlimited forms and no vendor-imposed software subscription or expiry. Deploy your own form submission endpoint and analytics/CSV dashboard on Cloudflare Workers and D1. The project documents a deployment fitting Cloudflare's free tier (up to 100,000 submissions/day and 4,000,000 stored submissions in its example), subject to Cloudflare's independently changing quotas.
watch_out: Free FormZero software is distinct from Cloudflare Workers/D1 hosted resources; infrastructure quotas, billing and overages follow Cloudflare's current plan. Requires your own Cloudflare account and deployment. README marks spam-protection and Resend email notifications as coming soon, not available features. No FormZero-managed free hosted service or VPS is included; avoid interpreting unlimited submissions as unlimited Cloudflare usage.
